body: Singapore Airlines (SIA) has announced its new first, business, premium economy and economy long-haul products, to arrive from 2027. The airline is investing S$2 billion ($1.56 billion) on its new products, which will be progressively introduced from the second half of 2027 on its 41 retrofitted Airbus A350-900 and A350-900 ultra-long-range (ULR) aircraft and upcoming new Boeing 777-9 widebody fleet. The new first, business, premium economy and economy cabins will feature across Singapore Airlines' new fleet of Boeing 777-9 widebodies, while the retrofitted A350-900s will feature the new business-class seat and the A350-900ULR fleet both business and first-class cabins for the first time.

The first-class cabins are designed to offer a 'luxurious private sanctuary,' featuring elegantly curved sliding doors for greater privacy and space, companion dining, and centre seats that can be converted into a two-seater sofa - or, as SIA describes it, the 'largest double bed in the sky'. The first-class entertainment experience features a 32-inch 4K high-resolution touchscreen display and spatial audio technology. Business class comes with full-grain premium leather upholstery with bespoke embroidery, layered textures, and metallic accents, as well as sliding privacy doors and electronically adjustable centre dividers. The full-flat bed measures 79 inches in length and up to 24 inches in width, and selected centre seats can be configured as companion beds when the dividers are lowered.

The new premium economy class seat on the new Boeing 777-9s includes a four-way adjustable headrest and a leg rest with an adjustable footrest, a 40-inch seat pitch, full-grain premium upholstery and plush cushioning. According to Singapore Airlines, the new economy seat on the Boeing 777-9s focuses on the fundamentals that matter most on long-haul journeys: wool-blend upholstery, ergonomic cushioning, a four-way adjustable headrest, and a redesigned seat reclining mechanism to provide greater knee and shin clearance. Lee Lik Hsin, chief commercial officer of Singapore Airlines, said each cabin was designed individually but all share the same ambition to make the experience more comfortable, flexible and rewarding for customers.
en.summary: Singapore Airlines has announced a S$2 billion ($1.56 billion) investment in new first, business, premium economy and economy long-haul products, to be progressively introduced from the second half of 2027 on 41 retrofitted Airbus A350-900 and A350-900ULR aircraft and its upcoming Boeing 777-9 fleet; first-class centre seats can convert into what SIA calls the 'largest double bed in the sky'.
en.title: Singapore Airlines unveils next-generation long-haul cabins in S$2 billion investment

body: 新加坡航空宣布推出全新頭等、商務、豪華經濟與經濟長程客艙產品，預計自2027年起陸續上線。航空公司將投資20億新加坡元（約15.6億美元），新客艙自2027年下半年起陸續推出，裝上41架改裝空中巴士A350-900與A350-900超長程（ULR）客機，以及即將引進的波音777-9廣體機隊。所有四種客艙將出現在新的777-9機隊；改裝的A350-900將換上新商務艙座椅，A350-900ULR機隊則首度同時配備商務艙與頭等艙。
頭等艙設計為「奢華私人庇護所」，配備弧形滑動門提升隱私與空間、雙人共餐，以及可併成雙人沙發的中央座位——星航稱之為「天空最大雙人床」；頭等艙娛樂系統配備32英寸4K高解析觸控螢幕與空間音訊技術。商務艙採用全粒面高級皮革包覆、專屬刺繡、層疊質感與金屬點綴，配備滑動隱私門與電動可調中央隔板；全平躺睡床長79英寸、最寬24英寸，部分中央座位放下隔板後可併為雙人床。
新777-9的豪華經濟艙座椅配備四向可調頭枕、附可調腳踏的腿托、40英寸椅距、全粒面高級皮革包覆與厚實坐墊。星航表示，新777-9的經濟艙座椅著重長程飛行最重要的基本需求，包括羊毛混紡布料、人體工學坐墊、四向可調頭枕，以及重新設計的椅背傾斜機構，提供更充裕的膝部與小腿空間。星航商務長Lee Lik Hsin表示，各客艙雖各自設計，但都懷抱同一目標：讓飛行體驗更舒適、靈活且更有收穫。
zh.summary: 新加坡航空宣布投資20億新加坡元（約15.6億美元）推出全新頭等、商務、豪華經濟與經濟長程客艙，自2027年下半年起陸續裝上41架改裝A350-900與A350-900ULR及新引進的777-9機隊；頭等艙中央座位可併成號稱「天空最大雙人床」。
zh.title: 星航斥資20億新元推出新一代長程客艙，2027年下半年起陸續上線
